newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chrysler to spend $10 mln on Brazil center.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to spend $10 mln on Brazil center.

text.p: Chrysler Corp's Brazilian unit said it will invest $10 million over the next two years to set up its automobile parts distribution center near Sao Paulo as it moves to consolidate its operations in Brazil.
Chrysler do Brasil said in a statement it has just inaugurated a 2,000-square-meter (yard) warehouse at Piracicaba, in Sao Paulo state, capable of storing 26,000 different items.
"With this investment, Chrysler should guarantee a 100-percent stock of components of vehicles sold by the company in Brazil," it said.
So far, Chrysler has spent close to $2.5 million to stock up on parts and expects to have spent $4 million by year's end to raise its stock to some 8,000 different components, it added.
